import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebras
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientEtale
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Geometrically.Reduced
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Unramified.Field

/-!
# Affine Galois descent for schemes

Speiser's algebra equivalence induces the affine base-change isomorphism used
in Milne III.1.13.  The construction is kept at the scheme level, with the
structure-map identity exposed for subsequent descent and quotient arguments.
Adapted from `AlgebraicJacobian/Descent/FiniteGaloisQuotientAffine.lean` in
the sibling Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild project.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.GaloisDescent

section GaloisCoverGeometry

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

/-- A finite Galois field cover is geometrically reduced. -/
theorem specMap_algebraMap_geometricallyReduced :
    GeometricallyReduced
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) := by
  rw [geometricallyReduced_iff,
    geometrically_iff_of_commRing_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
  intro E _ y
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable K L := IsGalois.to_isSeparable
  letI := Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_isSeparable K L
  haveI : IsReduced (E ⊗[K] L) :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field E (E ⊗[K] L)
  haveI : IsReduced (L ⊗[K] E) := by
    let e : L ⊗[K] E ≃ₐ[K] E ⊗[K] L := Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K L E
    exact isReduced_of_injective e.toRingEquiv e.toRingEquiv.injective
  exact isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion (pullbackSpecIso K L E).hom

end GaloisCoverGeometry

section SpecRingEquiv

/-- The spectrum isomorphism induced by a commutative-ring equivalence. -/
noncomputable def specRingEquivIso {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (e : S ≃+* T) : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of T) where
  hom := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (e.symm : T →+* S))
  inv := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (e : S →+* T))
  hom_inv_id := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      show (e.symm : T →+* S).comp (e : S →+* T) = RingHom.id S from
        RingHom.ext fun x => e.symm_apply_apply x,
      CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
  inv_hom_id := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      show (e : S →+* T).comp (e.symm : T →+* S) = RingHom.id T from
        RingHom.ext fun x => e.apply_symm_apply x,
      CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]

end SpecRingEquiv

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]

section PullbackSpec

variable (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra K C]

/-- `Spec C x_{Spec K} Spec L` in the tensor-factor order used by Speiser. -/
noncomputable def pullbackSpecLIso :
    pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K C)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (L ⊗[K] C)) :=
  pullbackSpecIso K C L ≪≫
    specRingEquivIso (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K C L).toRingEquiv

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd :
    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L (L ⊗[K] C))) := by
  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso]
  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst :
    (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[K] L ⊗[K] C).toRingHom) := by
  simp only [pullbackSpecLIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso]
  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2

/-- The tensor-product description of affine base change commutes with
morphisms of the original algebras. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackSpecLIso_inv_naturality {D : Type u} [CommRing D] [Algebra K D]
    (f : C →ₐ[K] D) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K L) f).toRingHom) ≫
        (pullbackSpecLIso K L C).inv =
      (pullbackSpecLIso K L D).inv ≫
        pullback.map _ _ _ _ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))
          (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
          (by
            rw [Category.comp_id, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
            congr 2
            exact f.comp_algebraMap.symm)
          (by simp) := by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst,
      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst_assoc]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
  · simp only [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id,
      pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    ext x
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]

end PullbackSpec

section AffineGalois

variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A]
  [IsScalarTower K L A]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A]
  [IsSemilinear K L A]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

/-- The affine Galois base-change isomorphism supplied by Speiser descent. -/
noncomputable def affineGaloisPullbackIso :
    pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap K (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
      ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A) :=
  pullbackSpecLIso K L (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) ≪≫
    specRingEquivIso (SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv K L A).toRingEquiv

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_snd :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).inv ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) := by
  simp only [affineGaloisPullbackIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso]
  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  ext a
  exact (SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv K L A).commutes a

/-- The descended projection is induced by inclusion of the invariant algebra. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_fst :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)).val.toRingHom) := by
  simp only [affineGaloisPullbackIso, Iso.trans_inv, specRingEquivIso]
  rw [Category.assoc, pullbackSpecLIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
    ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  ext x
  change SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv K L A (1 ⊗ₜ[K] x) = (x : A)
  rw [SemilinearAction.descentAlgEquiv_tmul, one_smul]

@[reassoc]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIso_hom_snd :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A)) = pullback.snd _ _ := by
  rw [← affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_snd K L A, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

/-- The affine Galois base-change isomorphism also identifies its first
projection with the map induced by the invariant subalgebra. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIso_hom_fst :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)).val.toRingHom) =
      pullback.fst _ _ := by
  rw [← affineGaloisPullbackIso_inv_fst K L A, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

/-- The affine Galois comparison, bundled as an isomorphism over the cover
`Spec L`. This records the typed affine base-change producer used by the
variety-level descent route. -/
noncomputable def affineGaloisPullbackIsoOver :
    Over.mk (pullback.snd
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap K (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≅
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L A))) :=
  Over.isoMk (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A)
    (affineGaloisPullbackIso_hom_snd K L A)

@[simp]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIsoOver_hom_left :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIsoOver K L A).hom.left =
      (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).hom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem affineGaloisPullbackIsoOver_inv_left :
    (affineGaloisPullbackIsoOver K L A).inv.left =
      (affineGaloisPullbackIso K L A).inv :=
  rfl

/-- The affine fixed-point base map is locally of finite type whenever the
semilinear algebra is finite type over the extension field. -/
theorem fixedPoints_specMap_locallyOfFiniteType
    [Algebra.FiniteType L A] :
    LocallyOfFiniteType
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap K (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L))))) := by
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType K
      (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) :=
    SemilinearAction.finiteType_fixedPoints K L A
  exact (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)).mpr
    (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)

end AffineGalois

section FieldInvariantEtale

variable (A : Type u) [Field A] [Algebra K A] [Algebra L A]
  [IsScalarTower K L A]
  [MulSemiringAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) A]
  [IsSemilinear K L A]
  [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

omit [Algebra K A] [IsScalarTower K L A] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] in
/-- A field with a semilinear finite Galois action is free away from the
identity. The witness is a scalar from `L`, whose image remains distinct
because the algebra map into the field `A` is injective. -/
lemma semilinear_field_action_free :
    ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L, g ≠ 1 →
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : A => g • a - a)) = ⊤ := by
  intro g hg
  apply ideal_span_smul_sub_eq_top_of_field_points g
  intro F _ x
  have hscalar : ∃ a : L, g a ≠ a := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hg
    ext a
    simpa using h a
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hscalar
  refine ⟨algebraMap L A a, ?_⟩
  intro hxa
  apply ha
  apply (algebraMap L A).injective
  apply x.injective
  rw [← SemilinearAction.smul_algebraMap (K := K) (L := L) (R := A) g a]
  exact hxa

omit [IsGalois K L] in
/-- The invariant subalgebra of a field-valued semilinear Galois algebra is
finite etale over the base field. -/
lemma semilinear_field_invariant_etale :
    Algebra.Etale (FixedPoints.subalgebra K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) A :=
  fixedSubalgebra_etale_of_free K A (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (fun g hg => semilinear_field_action_free K L A g hg)

end FieldInvariantEtale
end MilneLib.GaloisDescent
